newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks post small gain in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks post small gain in cautious trading.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed with a small gain on Wednesday, lifted by a late-session upturn following a day of cautious trading.
But the Nasdaq shares were overshadowed by blue chips as wary investors favored large-capitalization stocks, traders said.
Some investors stayed on the sidelines ahead of Thursday's release of fourth-quarter gross domestic product data and later Senate testimony by Fed chairman Alan Greenspan.
The Nasdaq composite ended up less than a point at 1355, with advancing and declining issues about even. Meanwhile the Dow shot up 85 points to 6741.
"There's no rush for people to get back into the market," said Peter Coolidge, senior equity trader at Brean Murray and Co, of the action on Nasdaq.
Quantum Corp jumped 3-1/4 to 36-3/8 after its fiscal third quarter earnings beat analysts' expectations. Bear Stearns and Goldman Sachs upgraded the stock.
Calgene Inc rose 1-31/32 to 7-15/32 after Monsanto Co proposed buying the remaining 47 percent of Calgene it does not already own for $7.25 a share.
